# SwiftLoop

> SwiftLoop is a web design, custom software and AI systems studio based in Dubai, UAE. We build conversion-focused websites, private operational platforms and reusable automations — and advise companies on adopting new technology without losing control of the work.

## What SwiftLoop does
- **Web design & development (Dubai):** custom marketing sites, e-commerce, and product UI built with Next.js, WebGL and headless CMS, engineered for speed and Core Web Vitals.
- **Luxury & jewelry website creation:** bilingual (English/Arabic) luxury e-commerce for jewelry, watches and premium brands, with AI-assisted inventory.
- **AI workflow automation:** replacing repetitive operations (leads, invoices, reports, follow-ups) with self-running pipelines.
- **AI agents & assistants:** RAG chat, support and voice agents trained on a client's knowledge base.
- **Custom business software:** private dashboards, portals, data models and role-aware workflows built around how a company actually operates.
- **AI advisory & adoption:** workflow audits, use-case prioritization, build/buy decisions, pilots, governance and team enablement for companies moving from experimentation to dependable systems.
- **Dealer OS:** a reusable Telegram-first, Supabase and n8n operations layer for high-touch retail, designed to adapt across watches, eyewear, jewellery and other inventory-led businesses.
- **Brand, motion & 3D:** identity systems and interactive Three.js / GSAP experiences.

## Location & contact

## Pricing (typical)
- One-time website builds typically range AED 4,000–7,000 depending on scope.
- Ongoing monthly retainers available for design + automation upkeep.
- Referral offer: one month free for successful referrals.

## How we work (the loop)
1. **Map** — audit the funnel and operations.
2. **Design** — prototype interface, motion and message in-browser; test with users.
3. **Automate** — deploy AI agents and integrations behind the site.
4. **Iterate** — report on results and tune design and prompts monthly.

## Bespoke systems and software
- **Dealer OS:** reusable high-touch retail operations layer with Telegram-first intake, schema-adaptable Supabase data, n8n workflows, AI-assisted product capture, inventory, listings and customer intelligence.
- **Dealer CRM Platform:** bespoke dealer CRM and operations platform with catalogue/inventory lifecycle, bidirectional website publishing, supplier and purchase records, expenses, recurring costs, invoice/PDF and reporting surfaces.
- **Talent Agency Management Software:** bespoke agency platform designed to cover talent, contacts, deals, campaigns, deliverables, meetings, revenue and secure client workspaces, with a planned custom AI agent system for platform guidance, next actions, workflow intake and bounded automation when complete.
- **Admin panels:** protected back-office environments for product and operations teams, with product editing, image ordering, permissions, availability and status controls, reporting, configuration and supporting workflow utilities.
- Much of this bespoke systems work is delivered privately, so it is not always represented as a public case study; the systems page describes the capabilities without exposing client data, credentials or engagement details.
